title: HTML overlays on video
blurb: A caption bar, a poll and a ticker in HTML over a video, in one canvas. Record it with sound, export it frame by frame with WebCodecs, or send it over WebRTC as a camera.
question: Can HTML drawn over a video in one canvas be recorded with the video's sound, exported with exact frames, and sent as a camera?
result: All three work. The export seeks the video and steps CSS animations one frame at a time.
